evidence:
Findings

Verified clean on the main axes. Typecheck (tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit) is silent, and the three new tests pass under the exact test:webcams invocation, so the new coverage genuinely runs. Both frame-resolver.test.mts and map-popup-faa-camera.test.mts were added to the test:webcams script in this commit.

Non-blocking observations

1. Low - resolved URL is only validated, never normalized. This is correct because a DOM property assignment must not carry HTML entity escaping, while sanitizeUrl returns an escapeHtml'd string. A comment would help prevent a later regression.
2. Low - no regression test covers the sanitizeUrl rejection branch. sanitizeUrl does block hostile and private-host image URLs, so behavior is right today.
3. Info - the post-resolve controller is nulled before image load completes. A later hide therefore does not abort the image fetch, but both load and error handlers re-check popup identity and no-op.

Resolver endpoint handling, CSP, popup replacement and close races, AbortController lifecycle, and i18n were checked and found sound. None of these observations rise to blocking.

CLAUDE REVIEW: APPROVED 88a2e5d9cd98def2ba72e398ee13fe48e81b0c66
